name: Copycat
source:
You'll help Mark, a regular guy who likes Lasagna and is married to Jessica, a pink-haired lady who is a excellent cook. One day, something really unusual happens to him and you'll have to follow the story until your time to take action!

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20231209105332/https://rpgmaker.net/games/8603/]rpgmaker.net[/url]]
